issues.title: Waterproof claim conflicts with specification
issues.explanation: The short description claims 100% waterproof protection, but the merchant specification states the fabric is suitable for light rain only, not immersion or heavy rain.

issues.title: Water bottle shown is not included
issues.explanation: The product image displays a water bottle alongside the backpack, which can lead customers to believe it is included. The specification confirms package contains one backpack only and the water bottle is a styling prop.

issues.title: FAQ does not clarify package contents
issues.explanation: The FAQ asks what comes with the order but gives a vague answer rather than stating that only the backpack is included and the water bottle is not.

issues.title: Laptop sleeve dimensions and device compatibility unconfirmed
issues.explanation: Customer feedback asks whether large work laptops fit inside the sleeve, but laptop sleeve dimensions and device compatibility have not been confirmed in the specification.
